**Português**

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes:
- Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele;
- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
- Procure se divertir!

#### ATENÇÃO  
##### É obrigatório o preenchimento do seguinte formulário com o nome do competidor e dos acompanhantes para entrar no condomínio. Caso não preencha até o fim do período de inscrições não será possível entrar no local.
[link do Formulário](https://forms.gle/ZqBvPD5L4yjKfhPg9)

**English**
It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions:
- Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate;
- The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it;
- At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice;
- If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists.
- Try to have fun!

#### ATTENTION
##### It is mandatory to fill in the following form with the name of the competitor and guests to enter the condominium. If you don't fill it in by the end of the registration period, will not be able to enter the site.
[form link](https://forms.gle/ZqBvPD5L4yjKfhPg9)

[FR]

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule).
En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](#34240-sante-securite-health-safety).

**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**.  Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**.  
**Vous ne pouvez pas vous inscrire à la fois au 5x5 à l'aveugle et au megaminx**. Vous devez choisir au maximum un des deux. Si vous mettez les deux, votre inscription ne sera pas acceptée.

[EN]

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule).
Due to the sanitary situation, the conditions for accessing the competition venue can vary due to the government's announcements. The organization team will inform everybody of the restrictions as they change. 

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](#34240-sante-securite-health-safety).

**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **without paying the registration fee**.
**You may not register for both 5x5 blindfolded and megaminx**. You must choose at most one of the two. If you put both, your registration will not be accepted.

This competition's profits are going to be donated to the nonprofit organization [The Happy Crew](https://www.thehappycrew.org/). The Happy Crew is a local nonprofit that aims to destigmatize mental health issues through community, and by creating an atmosphere of belonging for its participants. Currently, they are in great need for support due to their new project, Kākou Coffee House, which aims to elevate The Happy Crew's mission to a new level.

items.name: BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024
items.information:
BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin' featuring a variety of unofficial events.

The main focus of this competition will be its unofficial events, which are not sanctioned by the WCA. For more details and unofficial events registration, see the [Unofficial Events tab](#35589-must-read-unofficial-events).

## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube.

## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

We will be using Cubing Contests for live results for the unofficial events at this competition. See the [Live Results tab](#35619-live-results) for more information.

Competition day timing:
* The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
* Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
* Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
* Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

If you like big cubes and blindfolded solving, check out [BASC 57 - Big and Blind 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC57BigandBlind2024), a competition taking place in San Jose the same weekend as this one!
